capabilities: Create tension, substrate, principle, and presupposition notes via guided modals
Detect contradictory pairs across notes with the AI Contradiction Hunter
Track layer transitions (elevate, resolve, archive) through frontmatter without moving files
Map implicit presuppositions behind principles with AI
Visualize note layers in a clustered Cytoscape graph view
disambiguation: Not a decision-support system; AI-proposed contradiction pairs are prompts for thinking, not truths for real decisions.
extras: Warns that cloud AI calls incur per-token cost and that API keys are stored in plain text in the plugin settings file, which sync services would carry along. Detailed mobile-to-local-LLM setup guides (Tailscale, LAN, Cloudflare Tunnel). Onboarding includes a 7-card tutorial and a 21-note example vault.
motivation: The author frames it as the counterpart of Personal Knowledge Management: clean principles should emerge later, from resolving tensions, not before.
problem: Obsidian-based PKM workflows organize what you know, but have no structured way to capture and work through contradictions, anomalies, and conflicts between goals.
